events.title: Agrippa defeats Sextus Pompey's fleet off Naulochus
events.description: Off Naulochus in Sicily, Octavian's admiral Marcus Vipsanius Agrippa defeated the fleet of Sextus Pompey, son of Pompey the Great and last leader of organised opposition to the Second Triumvirate. Sextus was executed in Asia Minor the following year.

events.title: Gregory the Great is consecrated Pope
events.description: Gregory, a former prefect of Rome turned monk, was consecrated pope after months of reluctance. He reorganised the Church's estates, sent missionaries to England and shaped the medieval papacy.
events.html: Gregory, a former prefect of Rome turned monk, was consecrated pope after months of reluctance. He reorganised the Church's estates, sent missionaries to England and shaped the medieval papacy.

events.title: Byzantine forces destroy Umar al-Aqta's army at Lalakaon
events.description: In Paphlagonia, a Byzantine army under Petronas encircled and destroyed the forces of Umar al-Aqta, emir of Melitene, who had sacked Amisos on the Black Sea; Umar was killed. The victory began Byzantium's offensive on its eastern frontier.

events.title: The Mamluks defeat the Mongols at Ain Jalut
events.description: Near the spring of Ain Jalut in the Jezreel Valley, the Bahri Mamluks of Egypt under Qutuz and Baybars defeated a Mongol army of the Ilkhanate. It halted the Mongol advance into Egypt and confirmed the Mamluks as the dominant regional power.

events.title: Cromwell routs the Scottish army at Dunbar
events.description: Trapped against the coast, Oliver Cromwell attacked at dawn and shattered David Leslie's larger Scottish army. Dunbar opened the way to the English conquest of Scotland.
events.html: Trapped against the coast, Oliver Cromwell attacked at dawn and shattered David Leslie's larger Scottish army. Dunbar opened the way to the English conquest of Scotland.

events.title: The Treaty of Paris recognises American independence
events.description: British and American envoys signed the Treaty of Paris, ending the Revolutionary War and fixing the new nation's borders at the Mississippi. Britain signed separate treaties with France and Spain the same day.
events.html: British and American envoys signed the Treaty of Paris, ending the Revolutionary War and fixing the new nation's borders at the Mississippi. Britain signed separate treaties with France and Spain the same day.

events.title: Britain and France declare war on Germany
events.description: When Germany ignored ultimatums to withdraw from Poland, Britain and France declared war. Neville Chamberlain announced it to the nation in a sombre radio broadcast.

events.title: Italy secretly signs an armistice with the Allies
events.description: Italian and Allied officers signed the Armistice of Cassibile in Sicily, the same day British troops landed in Calabria. When it was announced on 8 September, Germany occupied much of Italy.

events.title: Sweden switches to driving on the right
events.description: At 4.50 am all traffic in Sweden stopped, changed sides and restarted on the right. Dagen H, 'H Day', went remarkably smoothly after years of preparation.
